title: Apply bounded skill installation and replacement
description: Apply verified candidate units within the user-authorized destination and replacement scope. It owns full preflight, safe scoped writes, preservation of unrelated content and detached originals, and honest partial-effect reporting; it does not manage project state or automatic upgrades.
inputs: Verified staged candidate, declared target roots and installation units.
Actual destination state and applicable normal or explicit whole-unit force request.
preconditions: Candidate trust and staging are established before installed-unit mutation.
outputs: Installed or replaced units and verified active-candidate outcome.
Blocked conflicts or safety conditions, known partial effects, untouched units, and retained-original locations.
behavior: Preflight every candidate unit and its actual path safety before writing; default conflicts include identical and empty existing units and stop the entire installation.
For applicable force, replace complete selected units and remove their obsolete contents without replacing shared parents or unrelated units.
Preserve the existing anchored-path, link, changed-basis, and no-clobber guarantees in both modes; reject platforms unable to support the required safe operation.
Keep detached originals outside discovery roots after success or failure and never treat them as active skills or automatic restoration authority.
Verify candidate hashes/counts and report actual effects; stop further writes on failure and require fresh verification/preflight and explicit replacement choice on retry.
Leave project-root state uninterpreted and unchanged; do not perform managed upgrades, retired-skill cleanup, or whole-project replacement.

failure_behavior.condition: Any unit conflicts without force or a destination is unsafe/inaccessible.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the full discovered conflicts or safety boundary and stop before installed-unit changes.

failure_behavior.condition: A destination or inspected basis changes during the operation.
failure_behavior.outcome: Stop without overwriting the new destination; preserve detached originals and identify known effects.

failure_behavior.condition: Application or final verification only partly succeeds.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report completed, failed, partial, detached, and untouched units without claiming rollback or complete installation.
